Description: Nullify managed EKS scan access (regional). Creates one EKS access entry per cluster for the Nullify read-only role created by nullify-cloudformation-template.json. Deploy once in each region that has clusters to scan, with CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND. Do not update with --use-previous-template.

CustomerName.Description: The CustomerName of the main Nullify stack. The access entry principal is arn:<partition>:iam::<this account>:role/AWSIntegration-<CustomerName>-NullifyReadOnlyRole, which must already exist.

ClusterNames.Description: Comma-separated EKS cluster names in this stack's region. Each cluster needs authentication mode API or API_AND_CONFIG_MAP. Names that differ only in non-alphanumeric characters (prod-eu and prodeu) collide; put them in separate stacks. Removing a name deletes that cluster's access entry.
ClusterNames.ConstraintDescription: Each cluster name must start with a letter or digit and contain only letters, digits, hyphens and underscores (max 100 characters).

KubernetesAuthorization.Description: RBACGroup (recommended): the access entry carries KubernetesGroupName; bind that group to the list-only ClusterRole in manifests/nullify-readonly-rbac.yaml or the nullify-k8s-readonly-access Helm chart. AmazonEKSAdminViewPolicy: no Kubernetes objects needed. WARNING: AmazonEKSAdminViewPolicy grants get, list and watch on every resource, including Secrets, custom resources and pods/log, and on EKS 1.34 and earlier get pods/exec is enough to exec into pods. Its grants do not show in kubectl auth can-i --list. AmazonEKSViewPolicy is not offered: it cannot list nodes, persistent volumes, Secrets, RBAC or admission objects.

KubernetesGroupName.ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, digits, '.' and '-' only (max 63 characters). ':' is not allowed, which excludes system: groups.
KubernetesGroupName.Description: Kubernetes group on the access entry when KubernetesAuthorization is RBACGroup. manifests/nullify-readonly-rbac.yaml binds nullify-readonly; for any other group, bind the nullify-readonly ClusterRole to it yourself. Ignored for AmazonEKSAdminViewPolicy.

AccessEntryArnCommand.Description: Prints the access entry ARN for one cluster in ClustersConfigured.

Value.Fn::Sub: aws eks describe-access-entry --region ${AWS::Region} --cluster-name CLUSTER --principal-arn arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/AWSIntegration-${CustomerName}-NullifyReadOnlyRole --query accessEntry.accessEntryArn --output text

PrincipalArn.Description: IAM role the access entries grant cluster access to.

AuthorizationMode.Description: Kubernetes authorization mode of the access entries.

KubernetesGroup.Description: Kubernetes group the RBAC binding must name.

ClustersConfigured.Description: Clusters with an access entry from this stack.

NextStepCommand.Description: Run for each cluster from a checkout of nullify-cloud-connector: applies RBAC (RBACGroup) and adds Nullify's egress IPs to publicAccessCidrs.

VerifyCommand.Description: Run for each cluster after NextStepCommand.
